scientific_conclusion: Source-grounded conditional task has two actually executed reference outcomes under declared geometry. Stowing the table clears floor but obstructs desk knees; working configuration reverses the tradeoff. This is reference feasibility, not learned design or generalization.
limits: All dimensions, initial poses, apertures and body thresholds are research assumptions.
Fixed bed and separate sofa replace original retractable bed; platform kitchen and rail mechanism are not reproduced.
Mobile table and stool are boxes: no real casters, pushing force, comfort or load validation.
Bathroom/kitchen/storage are static proxies: capacity, plumbing, operation and ventilation unknown.
Source read by task designer; family excluded from training/retrieval, not sealed or pretraining-unseen.
Only geometric activity proxies may pass. Independent professional or whole-room human-use acceptance is absent.
0.6m conservative body proxy fails bath-entry approach in every state; do not average it away.
Raw replay reserved_floor.scope retains a legacy bed-space label. Here its numeric bounds describe the central activity rectangle, not sleeping capacity. Raw evidence is preserved unchanged.
V1 rejected input and motion were repaired before native execution; evaluation task is developer-exposed, not sealed.
There is no model comparison on this task. Only one project family, with two conditions.
